title: SignalFolio: Intelligent Portfolio Research & Management Platform
description: A modular investment research and portfolio management platform designed to transform alternative financial data into actionable investment insights. It will ingest and analyze data from sources such as congressional stock trade disclosures, use deterministic strategy engines and LLM-powered research, and evaluate potential investment opportunities. Planned features include portfolio tracking, historical backtesting, risk management, and a simulated execution engine, with an emphasis on explainability, data integrity, and extensible architecture.
